page_annotations: Apart from these five blocks, the ruled page is blank. This was checked against the native tiles.
Marks reviewed that are not text: a faint pencil L-shaped mark in the bottom margin (approx. [730,4770,100,80]), small ink specks, and binding thread in the gutter.
Writing to the right of the gutter belongs to fol. 77 and is excluded.
unresolved_relationships: The parent entry of r003 is not identified.
The attachments of r002 and r005 to fol. 77 are inferred from arrows only.
The role of the circled word r004 is unclear.

coverage.finding: An ink '76' with a superscript 'b' and a stop is in the top-left corner (approx. [420,330,160,130]). The reading '76b.' is supported.

The single line is read as 'Begins yatkiñcid dānādi. i dampati pujānta[m/n] ka[r?]ma samāpya'. The word before 'samāpya' is visibly overwritten. The final letter of 'pujāntam' looks closer to 'n' or a looped 'm' and is not secure. A leftward arrow at the gutter (approx. x 3015-3175, y 630-670) with a hook and a short dash continues across the gutter. Its matching mark '←—7—' is visible beside c. 384 (10)e on fol. 77.

There are two lines and the second is indented. The source shows 'Svalpe' rather than 'Svalpa'. The abbreviation before 'Sk.' looks more like 'Calc' or 'Cale' than 'Cat.'. The first line ends 'Coll,', with a comma and no clear stop. That ending is also visible as the fragment 'c Sk. Coll,' at the left edge of fol. 77. No arrow is present.
A short word is enclosed in a hand-drawn oval (approx. [520,1500,280,190]). It is not securely legible and is kept as [illegible].

The line reads 'Ji Rasābhidheya, by Vaidyanātha Payagunde', followed by a wavy arrow pointing right. 'Rasā' and the following letters carry a stroke or overwriting. There are dots beneath 'Payagunde'. The matching entry on fol. 77 is 'd. 384 ... J. Rasābhidheya, by / Vaidyanātha Payagunde'.

review.boundary_review: The gutter is at about x 3170. Everything to its right, including the ticks, shelfmarks, 'a/??', the boxed d-group and the pencil 'ī/' near y 3500, belongs to fol. 77 and is excluded. The gutter arrow at b002 lies on the target side and continues across with a dash. The b005 arrow ends at about x 2570, well before the gutter. Both attachments to fol. 77 are inferred from the arrows and matching wording. They are probable, not proven.

region_review.top: This region holds the folio number b001 and the incipit line b002 with its gutter arrow.
region_review.middle: This region holds b003 (two lines), and lower down the circled word b004 and the cross-reference line b005. There is a stray dot near (655,1080) and ink specks near (430,2190) and (690,2420). These are not text.
region_review.bottom: The ruled lines are blank. There are small specks near (1400,4120) and a faint pencil L-shaped mark near (740,4770). No text was found.
region_review.left_margin: The left margin contains no writing beyond the start of b003.
region_review.right_margin: The gutter shows binding thread near y 2600. The writing beyond it belongs to fol. 77.
region_review.interlinear: No interlinear additions were found. The only alterations are the overwriting in b002 and the stroke in b005.
